name: group5-testing
description: Comprehensive Testing Suite for Group5 GPP Pharmacy Management System

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test:api: newman run tests/2-api-testing/postman/01_Auth.postman_collection.json -e tests/2-api-testing/postman/Group5_Local_Environment.postman_environment.json && newman run tests/2-api-testing/postman/02_Medicines.postman_collection.json -e tests/2-api-testing/postman/Group5_Local_Environment.postman_environment.json && newman run tests/2-api-testing/postman/03_Sales.postman_collection.json -e tests/2-api-testing/postman/Group5_Local_Environment.postman_environment.json && newman run tests/2-api-testing/postman/04_Imports.postman_collection.json -e tests/2-api-testing/postman/Group5_Local_Environment.postman_environment.json
